name: agent-issues
description: CLI for managing initiatives, PRDs, user stories, ADRs, and issues.

scripts.build: node --eval "import { rmSync, cpSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync('site/dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); cpSync('../site/dist', 'site/dist', { recursive: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.postbuild: node --eval "import { chmodSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; writeFileSync('dist/build-mode.js', 'export const BUILD_MODE = \"production\";\n'); chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755);"
